n2.text:
SPEC — collection pills are multi-select.
• Click toggles a pill on/off; selected pills show a check (aria-pressed).
• Alt-click = solo that collection.
• At least one stays selected; turning off the last one is ignored.
• Artist list = UNION of selected collections, de-duplicated, re-sorted by sort name; letter rail recomputed.
• An artist in 2+ selected collections shows once.
• 2+ selected → 'N selected · clear' appears (clear keeps the first in pill order); header reads 'Hip-Hop + Soul'.
• Keys: Space toggles focused pill, Alt+Space solos.
• Selection persists per media type (Music, Shows…).

n1.text: Kept from the TUI: density (30px rows, ~38 visible), monospace tabular times, keyboard-first. Added: scrubber with chapters + hover preview, interactive track chips, one consistent watched/progress encoding, drag/context menu, collapse states.
